append.detail: ── 2026-11-09 (task 18, first increment). lib/editor-crdt/node-ydoc.ts: NodeLayout <-> Yjs document (toYDoc, serializeLayout), encodeState/applyRemote for snapshots and peers, createClientUndo (tracks local origin only, so undo never reverts a collaborator) and editLocal. Proven by lib/editor-crdt/node-ydoc.test.ts over the frozen 37-document corpus: exact round trip, state encode/decode, two clients converge on different fields of one block, per-client undo. yjs is the only new dependency; y-prosemirror and the Tiptap collaboration extension arrive with E4 where they are first used. NOT YET: Realtime channel + server-side authz, awareness, debounced draft snapshot with sanitizeNodeLayout at the boundary, reconnect/offline replay, and the public-bundle ratchet (nothing public imports lib/editor-crdt). BLD-401 and BLD-403 build on this module.
